newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil posts $466 mln trade deficit in June. [CORRECTED 17:56 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Brazil posts $466 mln trade deficit in June. [CORRECTED 17:56 GMT]

text.p: Brazil posted a trade deficit of $466 million in the month of June, the Industry and Commerce Ministry said Tuesday.
Exports in June totalled $4.843 billion (corrects from million) while imports reached $5.309 billion, a ministry spokeswoman said.
In terms of daily averages, exports in June were $230.6 million and imports $252.8 million, the spokeswoman said.

In the fourth week of June, Brazil posted a trade deficit of $287 million, with exports of $1.123 billion and imports at $1.410 billion. On June 30, imports totalled $308 million and exports $259 million, the spokeswoman said.
